rationale: Recent export-side edits regressed badly, so this stays on the 0031/0004 recurrent-tail family and spends the change on validation alignment instead. It adds a compact late-phase curriculum that upweights the last stride-sized tokens of each training window only during quant-aware time, matching the final sliding-window scoring pattern without touching exact evaluation or the export path. I also deduplicated token-loss code so the script remains compact under the line cap.
title: Late Tail-Loss Curriculum
